summary: Full regression after the Supabase->MongoDB revert of /app/backend/server.py. Backend: 37 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (36 passed, 1 failed) covering health, auth (login/logout/me, cookie+bearer, case-insensitivity, bcrypt hash format in Mongo, brute force), admin stats/tags/batch/qr-zip/orders, public tag get/claim with phone+plate normalization and all 422/404/409 edge cases, and Razorpay orders config/create/verify(bad signature). Frontend: 4 Playwright runs covering landing (logo, hero, nav, faq, mobile), buy modal + LIVE Razorpay checkout open (no capture), /admin combined login+dashboard (invalid+valid login, session persistence, batch generation, logout), public vehicle scan page (plate, 3 languages, 5 reasons, call/whatsapp/emergency hrefs), business claim flow with validation, and 404 tag page. PRIMARY BUG IS FIXED: operator login works end-to-end (200 + JWT + httpOnly cookie) and dashboard loads.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / lockout. 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no 429/423 and no delay. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True. Response sends 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' AND 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true', which is spec-invalid: browsers will reject any credentialed cross-origin request, so the httpOnly cookie auth path silently cannot work cross-origin. Use explicit origin list.
Returns raw order docs including razorpay_signature and razorpay_payment_id; should be projected out of the admin listing.

Non-atomic claim (find_one then update_one). Two concurrent claims can both pass the status check; use find_one_and_update with {status:'unassigned'} filter. Also no rate limiting even though the public page displays 'Spam may get your IP and number blocked for up to 6 months.'

Returns tags_per_order: 3 (hardcoded) while backend TAGS_PER_ORDER = 1 tag actually allocated per order. Values are intentionally different (1 QR id, 3 language stickers) but the shared field name is misleading and will drift.

issues: Em dash in the h1 wraps onto its own line ('reach the owner —' / 'without an app.') producing an orphan dash
Large decorative taupe/brown blob sits directly behind the hero paragraph and CTA buttons, muddying contrast on mobile
Spam notice text (data-testid=spam-notice) is light purple on the purple background — low contrast, hard to read
faq-toggle has no aria-expanded attribute (returned None) — accessibility gap for an accordion control

action_items: Add brute-force lockout (5 failed logins) on POST /api/auth/login
Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with explicit origin list since allow_credentials=True
Make tag claim atomic (find_one_and_update with status filter) and add rate limiting to the public claim endpoint
Fix mobile hero em-dash wrap + spam-notice contrast; add aria-expanded to faq-toggle
critical_code_review_comments: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI — migrate to a lifespan context manager.
JWT is stored in localStorage ('necircle_token') while the backend also sets an httpOnly cookie; the localStorage copy negates the httpOnly protection (XSS token theft). Pick one mechanism.

next_id_from()/_allocate_tags_for_order() derive ids from max existing id without a transaction — concurrent batch creation or paid-order allocation can collide on the unique 'id' index and raise 500. Use a counter document with $inc.
_verify_signature is correct (HMAC-SHA256 over 'order|payment' with key secret) and rejects bad signatures with 400 as expected.

Created ~2 pending Razorpay LIVE orders for 'TEST Buyer' (order_TThhQam6r2Fqnf and one more) — NOT captured/paid, they remain 'pending'.

Only failing test is TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (feature genuinely absent). Note: use a fresh requests session (bare requests.*) for 401/no-auth assertions — the module-scoped session picks up the access_token cookie after any login call. Razorpay is LIVE: /orders/create is safe, never complete checkout. Frontend testids all present including stat-printed/activated/unassigned/orders, lang-en/kok/bn, reason-lights/no_parking/towed/open/wrong.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'operator login failed' was caused by the Supabase migration leaving users/tags tables absent, so login returned 401. The revert to MongoDB (motor) with startup admin re-seed resolves it: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with JWT + httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookie, GET /api/auth/me returns {email, role:'admin'} for both Bearer and cookie, and /admin renders the dashboard after submit. Verified admin doc exists in Mongo with a $2b$ bcrypt hash and that seed_admin rewrites the hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD no longer matches.
